title: hibiscus tomentosus
intro: Hibiscus tomentosus, commonly known as the hairy hibiscus or woolly hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The health benefits of Hibiscus tomentosus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as vasodilation, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
